content.text:
The strongest repository finding is that normal searches bypass the tracking event.

- Typing triggers a search after 250 ms once the term has at least three characters. That path calls `goto()` without `posthog.capture()` in [SearchPage.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:58). Defaults are in [search.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/search.ts:5).
- `search_submitted` fires only when the form submits, usually by pressing Enter, in [SearchPage.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:167). There is no submit button in the form.
- Example buttons call `updateQuery()` and skip capture in [SearchPage.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:244).
- Direct `/search?q=…` visits and reloads search on the server without an analytics event in [+page.server.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts:37).
- Retry emits an observability log, not `search_submitted`, in [SearchPage.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:108).
- Result clicks emit `search_result_selected` in [SearchPage.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:315).

PostHog initialization silently returns when either runtime setting is missing, and deliberately skips development, in [hooks.client.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/hooks.client.ts:9). Both settings are public **runtime** variables in [env.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/env.ts:9), so their absence from Docker build arguments does not establish a deployment bug.

History confirms the mismatch was introduced with instrumentation in commit `4331d60`, PR #99. Tracking was added to the submit handler while the existing typeahead path stayed unchanged.

Remaining production hypotheses: missing runtime configuration, deployed revision predating instrumentation, or ingestion/browser blocking. The repository alone cannot establish those.
